reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Further to the announcement dated 27th September 2024: RIGHTS ISSUE OF SHARES
reqBaseAnnouncement.votingShrsPropToBeIssued: 06 new ordinary shares for every 01 existing ordinary share
reqBaseAnnouncement.perposeOfTheIssue:
•	To meet the cost of re-locating the factory premises
•	To settle intercompany loans
•	To settle bank borrowings
•	To meet working capital requirements of the Company
•	To initiate the key measures to prevent further losses and support recovery which 
        was presented to the shareholders pursuant to Section 220 of the Companies Act on 
        17th September 2025.
